name: Ride a Box Down a Slide!
desc:
Ride a box down a slide and have fun with your friends!

Buy VIP for an exclusive morph or Super VIP for an exclusive sword!
If you're a premium user, VIP will be free!

Join the fan group for a free box and possibly more perks in the future! Fan group link: https://www.roblox.com/groups/15011269/Group

Note: this game was not 100% made by me, but is rather a revival of AviIius' original "Ride a Box Down Stuff!" with some new features added
